name: list_session_snapshots
description:
Retrieves a paginated list of snapshots for a specific project.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/snapshots --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return in the response. Used for pagination.

name.description: Name for the sandbox. Must be unique per project and URL-safe (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores).

project.description: The unique identifier or name of the project to list snapshots for.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction for results by creation time.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
